mapper.insert: INSERT INTO learning_chapter_progress(student_id,chapter_id,last_visited_at) VALUES(#{studentId},#{chapterId},NOW(6)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_visited_at=NOW(6)

INSERT INTO learning_chapter_progress(student_id,chapter_id,last_visited_at,completed_at) VALUES(#{studentId},#{chapterId},NOW(6),IF(#{completed},NOW(6),NULL)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE completed_at=IF(#{completed},COALESCE(completed_at,NOW(6)),NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT ch.id AS chapter_id,ch.title AS chapter_title,c.id AS course_id,c.title AS course_title,p.completed_at,p.last_visited_at FROM learning_chapter_progress p JOIN learning_chapter ch ON ch.id=p.chapter_id JOIN learning_course c ON c.id=ch.course_id JOIN learning_enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.id AND e.student_id=p.student_id AND e.active=1 WHERE p.student_id=#{studentId} AND p.completed_at IS NOT NULL AND ch.deleted=0 AND ch.status='PUBLISHED' AND c.deleted=0 AND c.status='PUBLISHED' ORDER BY p.completed_at DESC,ch.id DESC

SELECT ch.id AS chapter_id,ch.title AS chapter_title,c.id AS course_id,c.title AS course_title,p.last_visited_at FROM learning_chapter_progress p JOIN learning_chapter ch ON ch.id=p.chapter_id JOIN learning_course c ON c.id=ch.course_id JOIN learning_enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.id AND e.student_id=p.student_id AND e.active=1 WHERE p.student_id=#{studentId} AND ch.deleted=0 AND ch.status='PUBLISHED' AND c.deleted=0 AND c.status='PUBLISHED' ORDER BY p.last_visited_at DESC,ch.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.id AS student_id,s.nick_name AS student_name,s.user_name AS username,c.id AS course_id,c.title AS course_title, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learning_chapter ch WHERE ch.course_id=c.id AND ch.deleted=0 AND ch.status='PUBLISHED') AS total_chapters, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learning_chapter ch JOIN learning_chapter_progress p ON p.chapter_id=ch.id WHERE p.student_id=s.id AND p.completed_at IS NOT NULL AND ch.course_id=c.id AND ch.deleted=0 AND ch.status='PUBLISHED') AS completed_chapters, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignment a WHERE a.course_id=c.id AND a.status='PUBLISHED') AS assignment_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignment a JOIN assignment_submission sub ON sub.assignment_id=a.id WHERE sub.student_id=s.id AND a.course_id=c.id AND a.status='PUBLISHED' AND sub.status='SUBMITTED') AS submitted_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignment a JOIN assignment_submission sub ON sub.assignment_id=a.id WHERE sub.student_id=s.id AND a.course_id=c.id AND a.status='PUBLISHED' AND sub.status='GRADED') AS graded_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignment a JOIN assignment_submission sub ON sub.assignment_id=a.id WHERE sub.student_id=s.id AND a.course_id=c.id AND a.status='PUBLISHED' AND sub.status='RETURNED') AS returned_count, me.mood_level,DATE_FORMAT(me.week_start,'%Y-%m-%d') AS mood_week FROM learning_course c JOIN learning_enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.id AND e.active=1 JOIN sys_user s ON s.id=e.student_id AND s.role_id=10 AND s.status='0' LEFT JOIN mood_notice_ack ack ON ack.student_id=s.id AND ack.notice_version=#{noticeVersion} LEFT JOIN mood_entry me ON me.student_id=ack.student_id AND me.week_start=(SELECT MAX(m.week_start) FROM mood_entry m WHERE m.student_id=s.id) WHERE c.mentor_id=#{mentorId} AND c.deleted=0 AND c.status='PUBLISHED' AND c.id=#{courseId} AND (LOCATE(#{keyword},s.nick_name)>0 OR LOCATE(#{keyword},s.user_name)>0 OR LOCATE(#{keyword},c.title)>0) ORDER BY c.id,s.id
